name: Memories
author: Simitone
description: A timeline for each Sim, after The Sims 2: first kiss, wedding, a new job and promotions, babies, birthdays, the death of a relative, fires and burglaries. In a lot: Options > Memories, or F7. Under it is a layer that watches play for these events, for other packs to build on. A first stage, not yet run in the game.
